title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery Transportation files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Hebrew Rehabilitation Center for Aged.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds thet the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Jams Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-10)
